note: The design chain of custody (ADR-336): ruling (an ADR) -> design master (docs/design-system/master/) -> vendored bundle (docs/design/arp-face/) -> GUI 3 shell (docs/design/gui3*) -> engine (the stub today). One row per ruled design element: its ADR and clause, the lab it came from, the master component and version that hold it, the bundle export when it is not the component's own name, its shell place as `path: needle` (the file must contain the needle), its state, and a note. `superseded_by` marks a ruling a later ADR replaced. `state: unknown` is allowed only with `settle`, the evidence that would decide it: never guess a state. Every ADR in DECISIONS.md has a row or a `not_design` entry with a one-line reason. `labs` gives every lab in the design index its status (tools/gen_lab_index.py shows it); `not_labs` names the index's pages that are not labs. `vendoring.known_drift` records, pinned to the vendored file's sha256, any difference between the vendored copy and vendor(master) that the human has not yet ruled on. Update this file in the same PR as the hop it records. tools/design_chain_check.py (./verify fast) holds all of it to the tree.

states.ruled: An ADR rules it; the design master does not hold it yet (ADR-316: it cannot reach the shell until it does).
states.in-master: A component in docs/design-system/master/ holds it, at the named master version.
states.vendored: The vendored bundle (docs/design/arp-face/) defines it: the export named by `bundle`, or the component.
states.in-shell: The GUI 3 shell mounts it at the named place, from the bundle (ADR-316).
states.wired: In the shell and wired through the device seam to the engine (the no-audio stub today; IF-10 at stage 8).
